neighbours.label: ' not' in moral advice ('one should not', 'must not')
fire: Whatever happens, one should not lose heart.
Even in defeat, a person must not despair.
Fate may be harsh, yet we should not complain.
Life is short, so one should not waste it.
Luck plays a part, still you must not give in.
In hard times, people should not abandon their friends.
Sorrow will come, but we must not surrender to it.
Whatever the odds, one should not bow to fear.
quiet: Whatever happens, one should always keep heart.
Even in defeat, a person must always hope.
Fate may be harsh, yet we should always smile.
Life is short, so one should always enjoy it.
Luck plays a part, still you must always try.
In hard times, people should always help their friends.
Sorrow will come, but we must always rise above it.
Whatever the odds, one should always face fear.
